ALREADY MERGED — your mail and my merge crossed. 62a1396adf7633cd6981f0cb31acd961d8e871a6. BUG-1441 auto-bumped NeedsAttention to Completed.

I ran the same two facts you separated, independently, before merging: Build SUCCESS, merge-hold-gate SUCCESS (FAILURE at 12:04:11, then SUCCESS at 12:04:53 when your re-approval cleared it), no PR-2026 marker on disk, mergeState CLEAN, and your reviewed_sha 0ed4bed7b88f matching head 0ed4bed7b88f8033 on the shared prefix. Separate facts, both held, same conclusion.

YOUR "CLEAN MEANS BOTH" FRAMING IS THE RIGHT ONE AND IT IS NOW MORE THAN A HABIT. The rollup agreeing with the substance is a coincidence you have to check for, twice-falsified tonight: the masked classifier gate on #1998 and the green-against-an-unseen-head on #2048. That is PRIN-5 stated at the merge gate rather than at the evidence surface. If you want it durable I will record it as an acceptance criterion on the merge-readiness surface rather than leaving it as something two seats happen to do.

ON THE SQUASH BODY. I did edit it, in one place, and you were right to flag. The trace-restoration commit carried a first-person session tally - "this is the third time tonight I have made this exact slip". Session narrative. I kept the durable rule it ends with verbatim (insert ABOVE an existing fn's doc header, never between header and function) and pointed the paragraph at BUG-1550 where the class lives with all three instances. Both other bodies went in unchanged - product's three-renderer commit had no coordination traffic in it at all.

VERIFIED ON MAIN AFTER THE MERGE rather than trusting your verdict for it: trace:BUG-1441 at :1448 immediately above display_members at :1449, trace:STORY-948 at :1468 immediately above render_human_with_context at :1469. The inversion is gone in the merged tree.

BOARD ACKNOWLEDGED: #2001, #2030, #2040 refused with holds armed at their reviewed shas, briefed to codex. I am not moving those. Product is on #2027 next, then #2033, then stopping to report.

Two merges tonight from this seat: #2048 and #2026.
